projects.category: Brand Identity · App Design · Visual Identity
projects.title: iNeed
projects.headline: On-Demand Service Brand & Visual Identity
projects.impact: A complete brand identity system for a multi-service on-demand platform — logo, app icon, visual language and sub-brand architecture across iNeed, iNeedhome and iNeedCar.
projects.overview: iNeed is a multi-service on-demand platform connecting users with delivery, home services and transportation. The project required a complete brand identity system — from the primary wordmark and app icon through to a structured sub-brand architecture covering three distinct service lines.
projects.challenge: Building a unified identity flexible enough to support three distinct service categories — each with its own colour and character — while maintaining instant recognition as a single platform. The mark needed to perform at app icon scale and on outdoor advertising equally.
projects.solution: A custom iNeed wordmark with a distinctive arrow-integrated N letterform that communicates direction and delivery at a glance. A rounded-square app icon carries the N mark across all digital surfaces. The sub-brand architecture uses colour as the primary differentiator: electric blue for iNeed, red for iNeedhome, yellow for iNeedCar — unified by a shared typographic and iconographic system.

projects.category: Brand Identity · App Design · Mobile UI
projects.title: chargenest
projects.headline: EV Charging Platform Brand & App Design
projects.impact: A complete brand identity and app design system for a sustainable urban mobility startup — from logo and app icon through industrial design concepts and outdoor advertising.
projects.overview: chargenest is a technology platform for sustainable urban mobility, enabling EV drivers to find, book and use charging stations through a dedicated mobile application. The project required a complete creative system — from brand mark and identity through to mobile app UI, industrial design exploration and outdoor advertising.
projects.challenge: Building a brand that communicates reliability and forward-thinking innovation for an emerging market — EV charging — without feeling technical or intimidating. The identity needed to work simultaneously across a mobile app, physical charger hardware and outdoor advertising at street scale.
projects.solution: A custom C emblem fusing the letter C with an electric plug form — simple, memorable and instantly readable at any size. The bright mint green signals energy, sustainability and forward motion. The rounded wordmark keeps the brand approachable while the overall system maintains authority. Industrial design sketches explored 20+ charger form factors, while the mobile UI was crafted for fast, confident slot booking.

projects.category: Brand Identity · Web Design · Corporate Identity
projects.title: EverCraft
projects.headline: IT Solutions Brand Identity & Corporate Design System
projects.impact: A complete corporate identity system for a technology solutions company — logo, stationery, social media templates, website design, company profile and environmental signage.
projects.overview: EverCraft Solution is a technology company established in 2011, focused on delivering innovative, reliable and scalable IT solutions across consulting, software development, system integration and ongoing support. The project called for a complete corporate identity system communicating authority, trust and forward-thinking capability across every touchpoint — from business card to billboard.
projects.challenge: Building a brand identity that feels established and trustworthy while remaining modern and forward-looking. The system needed to unify a complex multi-service offering under a single visual language that scales consistently across print, digital and environmental applications.
projects.solution: A geometric origami bird mark — constructed from precise polygonal facets — communicates precision, intelligence and the concept of solutions taking flight. The deep navy and electric blue palette signals corporate authority with technological energy. The identity extends cohesively across stationery, social media templates, responsive web design, company profile documentation and environmental signage.

projects.category: Brand Identity · Marine Services · Corporate Identity
projects.title: cata
projects.headline: CATA Marine Solutions — Brand Identity System
projects.impact: A complete corporate brand identity for a ship repair and marine services company — built on precision, reliability and maritime authority.
projects.overview: CATA Marine Solutions is a specialized ship repair and marine services company built on the values of reliability, precision and power. The project called for a complete brand identity system communicating technical authority and maritime expertise — from the foundational logo and corporate system through social media, a professional website, company profile and environmental branding.
projects.challenge: Creating a brand identity that conveys the precision and reliability demanded in marine engineering — an industry where trust is earned through consistency and proven capability. The identity needed to feel authoritative enough for B2B procurement contexts while remaining approachable and modern across digital platforms.
projects.solution: A strong wordmark anchored by the lowercase 'cata' in bold, confident typography — paired with a marine orange accent that cuts through the deep navy palette. The corporate identity system extends cohesively across stationery, social media templates, a professional website, comprehensive company profile and environmental signage. Vehicle applications bring the brand to life in the field, reinforcing presence at every touchpoint.

projects.category: Web App · Real Estate · UI Design
projects.title: iNeedhome
projects.headline: iNeedhome — Real Estate Platform & Web App Design
projects.impact: A complete real estate platform design — brand identity, UI system, responsive web application and full product feature set for property search, listing and booking.
projects.overview: iNeedhome is a real estate platform and web application enabling users to search, filter and book property viewings across Buy, Rent and Commercial categories. As a sub-brand of the iNeed ecosystem, the project required a complete brand identity system, comprehensive UI design system and a fully responsive web application — from hero search to property detail, agent contact and appointment booking flows.
projects.challenge: Designing a complex real estate platform that feels intuitive despite the volume of filters, listing types and user flows it must support. The interface needed to balance feature richness with clarity — guiding first-time buyers and experienced agents alike through the same product with equal ease.
projects.solution: A clean, conversion-focused design system built on Poppins typography and a clear three-colour palette — blue for trust and navigation, red for action and urgency, yellow for accent states. The component library covers all platform surfaces: search, listing grids, property cards, interactive maps, user dashboard, agent contact flows and appointment booking. The responsive system scales consistently from 320px mobile to 1440px+ desktop.

projects.category: SaaS · Social Media Management · UI/UX Design
projects.title: dreamCloud
projects.headline: dreamCloud — Social Media Management Platform
projects.impact: A complete SaaS product design for a social media management platform — brand identity, UI design system, dashboard application and full feature ecosystem across scheduling, analytics, AI tools and team collaboration.
projects.overview: dreamCloud is a social media management SaaS platform enabling brands and teams to plan, schedule, analyse and collaborate on content across Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest and Google Business — all from a single dashboard. The project required a complete brand identity system and a comprehensive UI/UX design covering every surface of the product.
projects.challenge: Designing a feature-rich SaaS dashboard that manages the complexity of multi-platform social media operations without overwhelming users. The platform needed to serve both solo creators and enterprise teams — with a UI architecture that scales gracefully from simple post scheduling to AI-assisted content creation, campaign management and performance analytics.
projects.solution: A clean purple-to-blue gradient brand language built on Poppins — approachable yet professional, signalling intelligence and creativity. The product UI organises complex functionality through a clear sidebar navigation, modular widget system and contextual panels. Key surfaces include: an analytics dashboard, content calendar, AI caption generator, social inbox, post scheduler, team collaboration, approval workflow, campaign management and performance reporting — all responsive from 390px to 1440px+.

projects.category: YouTube Ecosystem · Brand Identity · Content Production
projects.title: Beyond Midnight Waves
projects.headline: Beyond Midnight Waves — YouTube Ambient Music Ecosystem
projects.impact: A complete YouTube channel ecosystem built from scratch — brand identity, content architecture, music production direction, album art system, thumbnail design system and full visual language for an ambient music channel with 1.05B+ total subscribers.
projects.overview: Beyond Midnight Waves is an ambient music YouTube channel built around focus, relaxation and deep sleep — featuring soundscapes, meditation music, piano pieces and nature sounds. The project covered the complete creative ecosystem: brand identity and visual language, YouTube channel design, playlist and content architecture, music production direction, album art for 10+ releases, a comprehensive thumbnail design system, and distribution across Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music.
projects.challenge: Building a distinct, atmospheric visual identity for a saturated niche — ambient YouTube — that stands out on a platform dominated by algorithmic thumbnails. The identity needed to feel immersive and premium across every surface: channel banner, video thumbnails, album covers, streaming platform profiles, CD packaging and social media. All at scale, for a content system producing 170+ videos.
projects.solution: A deep-space visual language grounded in aurora borealis, nocturnal landscapes and atmospheric light. The 'bg' lettermark fuses two initials into a flowing, organic mark that reads equally as a wave symbol. The palette runs from near-black navy through deep purple to electric blue and soft lavender — a 7-step gradient system that mood-codes content categories: Sleep, Meditation, Focus, Nature, Piano and Rain. The thumbnail system uses consistent compositional rules, mood-coded colour temperature and a 30+ icon library — enabling rapid production at series scale.

projects.category: YouTube Ecosystem · Kids Entertainment · Character Design
projects.title: Mini Melody Song
projects.headline: Mini Melody Song — Kids YouTube Channel Ecosystem
projects.impact: A complete kids YouTube channel creative ecosystem — brand identity, 10-character 3D universe, channel design, thumbnail system, video production framework and full merchandise line for a 2.37M subscriber children's music channel.
projects.overview: Mini Melody Song is a kids and family entertainment YouTube channel producing fun, educational and musical video content for young children. The project built a complete creative ecosystem from the ground up — a distinctive brand identity, a 10-character 3D animal universe, YouTube channel design, thumbnail and content system, video production framework, and an extensive merchandise line covering toys, apparel, stationery, party supplies and a mobile app.
projects.challenge: Creating a kids brand that is simultaneously joyful and safe, educational and entertaining, recognisable at thumbnail scale and scalable across hundreds of videos. Every element, from character expressions to thumbnail composition, had to delight children while earning trust from parents — and remain replicable by a production team at high volume.
projects.solution: A bold, rounded wordmark in complementary gradient colour — pink and yellow-orange — paired with a bright 6-colour palette and Baloo 2 typography. Ten original 3D animal characters — each with distinct personality, expressions, actions and poses — form the heart of the brand. A structured thumbnail system with 4 templates, A/B variants and category colour coding enables high-CTR production at scale. The content architecture spans 8 playlist categories, a 6-stage video story flow and a Shorts ecosystem. The brand extends across a full merchandise line: toys, clothing, bags, stationery, party supplies, mobile app and room decor.
